title: GTM Strategy: Price Alerts & Watchlist — TradeEasy
positioning_statement: For retail investors who miss price opportunities because they can't watch screens all day, TradeEasy Price Alerts is a real-time notification system that tells you the exact moment a stock hits your target price. Unlike limit orders that execute automatically, Price Alerts give you control — you decide whether to trade when the moment arrives.

target_segments.description: Log in ≥3×/week, hold 5–20 positions, trade 10–20 times per month
target_segments.rationale: Highest-frequency users; most likely to set multiple alerts and generate trade events from alerts; already use watchlist

target_segments.description: Use watchlist but rarely trade; check portfolio weekly
channels: Push notification: 'Your watchlist just got smarter'
target_segments.rationale: Large segment (68K users) already invested in the watchlist surface; alerts directly extend their current behaviour

target_segments.description: Had TradeEasy accounts but stopped logging in; likely using a competitor for alerts
channels: Re-engagement email with deep-link to alert creation on their top held position
target_segments.rationale: Price alerts are a proven re-engagement hook; alerts give dormant users a reason to return without requiring active trading intent

messaging_framework.headline: Know the moment it moves.
messaging_framework.sub_headline: Set a price target on any stock or ETF — TradeEasy alerts you the instant it's hit so you can decide whether to act.
supporting_bullets: Instant: push notifications arrive within 30 seconds of your target price being crossed
In control: alerts don't execute automatically — you decide when to trade
Connected: sync with your watchlist and set an alert in one tap

key_activities: Brief support team on top 5 FAQs and escalation path
Legal sign-off on all notification copy templates
App store screenshots and 'What's New' copy finalised
Internal beta with 50 opted-in active traders
launch_timeline.success_signal: Zero P0 issues in internal beta; all copy approved by Legal

key_activities: App store release with updated screenshots
In-app announcement banner (dismissable, shown once) to 100% of users
Push notification to watchlist users: 'Your watchlist just got smarter'
Monitor notification delivery rate, alert-set funnel, crash rate daily
launch_timeline.success_signal: ≥15% of active traders set at least one alert in first 7 days; crash rate stays below 0.6%

key_activities: Email re-engagement campaign to 31K dormant users (Week 4)
Deep-link from email directly to alert creation for their top held position
A/B test tagline variants on onboarding tooltip
Analyse conversion rate (alert triggered → trade executed) and surface insights to PM
launch_timeline.success_signal: ≥8% of dormant users reactivate (vs 3% baseline); 25% of MAU have set ≥1 alert by day 60

competitive_positioning.top_threat: Competitor B — offers 30-second push alerts with alert history but lacks watchlist integration
competitive_positioning.response_playbook: When a prospect raises Competitor B, acknowledge their alert speed parity, then pivot to integration: TradeEasy alerts are created in one tap from your existing watchlist, and the notification deep-links directly to a pre-filled order ticket. Competitor B requires switching apps to execute. Our retention metric is the trade that follows the alert, not just the alert itself.

we_win_when.scenario: User already has a TradeEasy watchlist
we_win_when.why_we_win: Alert creation requires zero context-switching; one tap from the watchlist row to set an alert

we_win_when.scenario: User wants to act on an alert immediately
we_win_when.why_we_win: Notification tap deep-links to a pre-filled order ticket — no navigation required

we_win_when.scenario: User values control over automatic execution
we_win_when.why_we_win: Alerts inform, limit orders commit — our messaging explicitly addresses this anxiety

we_lose_when.scenario: User wants complex conditional alerts (% change, moving average)
we_lose_when.why_we_lose: MVP supports simple price-crossing alerts only
we_lose_when.mitigation: Acknowledge and commit to Phase 2 timeline; position simple alerts as 'the reliable foundation'

we_lose_when.scenario: User is on web and wants push notifications
we_lose_when.why_we_lose: Web users get email-only alerts in MVP
we_lose_when.mitigation: Frame as 'alerts wherever you check email'; Phase 2 will add web push

leading_indicators.metric: Alert-set rate (% of MAU who create ≥1 alert)
leading_indicators.measurement: DB count on price_alerts WHERE created_at > launch_date

leading_indicators.metric: Alert creation funnel completion rate (tapped Set Alert → created)

lagging_indicators.measurement: Login event from dormant cohort after campaign send

lagging_indicators.metric: Alert-to-trade conversion rate (alert triggered → trade within 24h)
lagging_indicators.measurement: Join on alert triggers and order submissions by user_id, ticker, 24h window
